profile.name: BACnet楼宇自动化控制器
profile.description: 这是一类支持 BACnet 协议的楼宇自动化现场设备或控制器，常用于连接和管理暖通空调、环境传感器、执行器、电表、报警点位等。它可在网络中发布设备与对象信息，并允许读取或写入各类点位属性。在实验室或科研设施中，这类设备常用于房间环境监测、空调与通风联动、能耗采集以及楼宇基础设施集成。
profile.description_en: This is a BACnet-compatible building automation field device or controller used to interface with HVAC equipment, environmental sensors, actuators, utility meters, and alarm points. It exposes device and object information on the network and allows properties of points to be read or written. In laboratories and research facilities, such devices are commonly used for room environmental monitoring, HVAC and ventilation coordination, energy data collection, and facility infrastructure integration.
